summary: Phase 2.6 (Custom Fields + Catalog Mode + Self-Profile) validated end-to-end. 29/29 new backend pytest tests pass (test_phase26_customfields_catalog.py), 18/18 phase 3 regression tests still pass. Frontend flows: Custom Fields admin page (all 5 module tabs + Add dialog + 7 field types + options), dropdown field renders in Dealer Add modal under 'CUSTOM FIELDS' section, Branding page catalog-mode-select toggles enquiry_only, Customer PWA correctly hides prices/shows Enquire buttons (5 products) in enquiry_only mode, submits enquiry on click, and reverts to Add-to-Cart with ₹prices in direct mode. Customer /shop/account save-profile-btn works.

minor.issue: Duplicate-key check does not filter by is_active — a soft-deleted field with the same field_key still blocks re-creation with 400. Consider adding `"is_active": True` to the existence lookup (server.py:1473) so admins can re-add a previously deleted field with the same key.

ui_bugs.issue: No data-testid on the per-option text input inside the Add Custom Field dialog (label uses '+ Add option' button). Selector by placeholder works but adding e.g. data-testid='cf-option-{idx}' would improve testability.

integration_issues.flow: Live catalog_mode toggle for an already-logged-in customer
integration_issues.issue: When tenant admin changes catalog_mode (direct <-> enquiry_only), a currently-open customer session does not pick up the new mode on soft reload — AppContext appears to cache tenant profile at mount and doesn't refetch on route reload. A hard new session/login shows correct mode. Consider re-fetching /api/tenant/profile on Catalogue mount or exposing a refreshTenant() call.

action_items: (LOW) Fix duplicate-key check on POST /api/custom-fields to ignore soft-deleted (is_active=false) fields (server.py line ~1473).
(LOW) Refresh tenant profile on Customer Catalogue/Cart mount so catalog_mode toggles by admin propagate to already-open customer sessions (or expose refreshTenant() from AppContext).
(LOW) Add data-testid to per-option input inside CustomFieldsForm.jsx (cf-option-{idx}).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is ~1928 lines — still growing; consider splitting into routers/ (auth, users, custom_fields, orders, tenant, analytics) before next phase for maintainability.

GET /api/custom-fields is called by every 5 forms (dealer/customer/product/visit/enquiry) with no client-side caching — consider a single AppContext.customFields state loaded once per session, or use SWR/react-query for auto-dedup.

PATCH /api/me/profile accepts arbitrary custom_data dict for the logged-in user with no validation against defined CustomField schema (e.g., required visible_to_customer fields aren't enforced server-side). Consider validating custom_data keys against CustomField definitions where visible_to_customer=true and required=true.
OrderIn.items should validate quantity > 0 (currently allows 0/negative quantities which would create zero-total orders).

Custom field field_key normalization (`.strip().lower().replace(' ','_')`) is done only on POST, not on PATCH — if PATCH ever accepts field_key changes, key drift could occur (though PATCH schema currently excludes field_key, this is safe today).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend supports: 5 modules (dealer/customer/product/enquiry/visit), 7 field types (text/textarea/number/date/dropdown/radio/checkbox). Custom fields are per-tenant, per-module, and rendered on ALL create/edit forms plus the customer /shop/account page. Catalog mode 'enquiry_only' blocks POST /api/orders with 400 for both dealer & customer, and the Customer PWA replaces Add-to-Cart with Enquire buttons (data-testid='enquire-{pid}'). /api/me/profile PATCH is the self-edit endpoint. Note: catalog_mode toggle is NOT live for already-open customer sessions — reload/re-login required. Duplicate check on POST /api/custom-fields includes soft-deleted rows.
